product_overview: AvukatAğı is a digital collaboration platform for lawyers facilitating job sharing, task management, and premium subscription services to enhance professional networking and operational efficiency.
core_goals: Enable lawyers to create and manage professional jobs efficiently within a collaborative network.
Provide seamless user authentication and profile management with secure session handling.
Implement a robust premium subscription system supporting multiple plans and secured payment integration.
Deliver real-time notifications through SMS, push, and Telegram to keep users updated on job-related activities.
Offer comprehensive admin tools for monitoring platform metrics, managing users, jobs, and resolving disputes.
Ensure platform security with role-based access control, RLS policies, and payment security protocols.
key_features: User Authentication with Email/Password and phone verification via SMS through Supabase Auth integration.
Detailed Lawyer Profiles including Baro Number, City, Specializations, and Avatar management.
Job Management system allowing job creation, listing with filters, job application windows (urgent and standard), and automated status updates.
Premium Membership subscription plans (monthly, yearly) with payments via Garanti BBVA Virtual POS 3D Secure gateway.
Multichannel Notifications including SMS alerts, push notifications via Firebase/FCM, and Telegram bot integration for real-time updates.
Admin Dashboard featuring metrics, user and job management, bot control for synthetic job activity, push notification management, and dispute resolution interfaces.
Automated Cron Jobs managing job application windows, premium expiry notifications, and synthetic job creation to simulate activity.
Security enhancements including Supabase RLS policies, admin route protection, 3D secure payment hash verification, and role-based access control.
user_flow_summary: User Registration and Login with email confirmation and optional SMS phone verification.
Profile Completion and Editing, including uploading avatar and entering professional qualifications.
Job Creation workflow for lawyers to post new jobs specifying type, location, fee, and urgency.
Job Listing and Browsing with filters by City and Job Type, including viewing job details and application deadlines.
Job Application process differentiated by urgent and standard jobs with strict timing windows and automated owner notifications on timeout.
Premium Subscription purchase flow starting from plan selection, payment through Garanti BBVA 3D Secure, handling success or failure callbacks.
Notification subscriptions and receipt via SMS, push, and Telegram with user preferences management.
Admin access flow including login, dashboard usage, user/job management, dispute handling, and push notification sending.
validation_criteria: All user registration, login, and password reset flows function correctly with secure session tokens issued.
Jobs can be created, listed, filtered, and their status transitions automatically on timed events as specified.
Premium subscription purchases are processed securely with 3D Secure integration and proper backend callbacks.
Notifications are received timely and correctly by SMS, push, and Telegram channels according to user settings and job events.
Admin dashboard metrics reflect accurate real-time platform data; admin operations perform correctly with access control enforced.
Cron jobs trigger at defined intervals and perform tasks such as job bot activity, application window watching, and premium expiry alerts.
Security policies and role-based access prevent unauthorized data access or action execution; payment data is safely handled.
